Consolidación del corpus de literatura Q: Consolidation of the recent Q1/Q2 literature corpus, extracting the seed references and indexing the papers graph and the knowledge vault.
Redacción del MGA resumido (problema cen: Writing the summarized MGA (central problem of the tree, context, expansion of the three direct causes and magnitude with a baseline indicator table) and, from it, the problem description (§3) with the central question.
Estado del arte e hipótesis: State of the art and hypothesis
Construcción del estado del arte con ref: Building the state of the art with Q1/Q2 references (§4), formulating the falsifiable hypothesis (§5) and drawing the visual map of the state of the art.
Elaboración de la justificación y pertin: Writing the justification and relevance (§2), linking the solution to the SDGs, the National Development Plan and technology readiness level TRL 6 or 7.
Formulación del objetivo general (§6) y: Formulating the general objective (§6) and the three specific objectives (§7), ensuring a strict one-to-one mapping with the subproblems.
Solo flujo SGR: siembra la cadena de val: SGR flow only: seeds the value chain from the approved objective tree (`scripts/cadena_valor_sgr.py init`), with DNP catalogue products, indicator and target per specific objective and technical activities with code, critical path and months; `check` validates it and the user approves it in the Value chain tab.
Desarrollo de los fundamentos teóricos (: Developing the theoretical foundations (§8) and forming the work team (§9), deriving operational roles directly from the specific objectives.
Solo flujo SGR: productos CTeI por encim: SGR flow only: STI products above the call minimum, a public science outreach strategy, the human talent to hire with the call minimums and management indicators as data in `artefactos/sgr/productos.json`, linked to the value chain products; `scripts/productos_sgr.py check` validates them, `render` generates §36 and §37 (and §15 in Phase 6.45) and the user approves them in the Products and indicators tab.
Estructuración de la metodología (§10) p: Structuring the methodology (§10) by phases and value chain, together with the specification and deterministic check of the TikZ diagram.
Solo flujo SGR: ruta y verificación del: SGR flow only: TRL route and verification, transfer, social appropriation of knowledge with its seven elements, sustainability, later use and differential measures as data in `artefactos/sgr/componentes.json`, linked to the value chain activities; `scripts/componentes_sgr.py check` validates them, `render` generates §31 to §35 and the user approves them in the TRL and components tab.
Definición de los resultados e impactos: Defining the expected results and impacts (§11) and grounding the ethical and data management considerations (§12).
Solo flujo SGR: participantes, población: SGR flow only: participants, population, alternatives and risks, in the MGA order, because the budget (§13) pays for handling the participants and mitigating the risks.
Construcción del presupuesto (§13) detal: Building the budget (§13) with its items, counterpart contributions and co-funding, in an arithmetic balance that can be checked against the call terms.
Planificación del cronograma de activida: Planning the activity schedule (§14, Gantt), consolidating the deliverables table (§15) and the bibliography in BibTeX APA (§16).
Diseño de la articulación comunitaria te: Designing the territorial community engagement (§17) and the social appropriation of knowledge plan (§18) with the communities of interest.
Solo flujo SGR: alineación con los plane: SGR flow only: alignment with the development plans, value chain with its evaluation and logical framework matrix, plus identification, territorial demands and responsibility matrix (rendered from the alliance data), suitability and track record of the entities and a summary of funding sources (rendered from the budget).
Redacción del resumen técnico, resumen e: Writing the technical abstract, the institutional executive summary and the keywords, and a final check of the definitive title in the header.
Solo flujo SGR: lista de los requisitos: SGR flow only: list of the call's eligibility requirements and the institutional endorsement, with status, responsible entity and attached document, figures declared in the annexes (SIGP, Annex 1, Annex 3 and MGA Web) and licenses and permits as data in `artefactos/sgr/requisitos.json`; `scripts/requisitos_sgr.py init` seeds it from the rubric, `scripts/requisitos_sgr.py check` validates it, `render` generates §38 and §39 and the user ticks the requirements and approves them in the Requirements and annexes tab.
Auditoría cruzada integral de dependenci: Full cross audit of dependencies, consistency check across sections, document assembly and compilation of the final PDF.
